titleEn: Maximum Level Sum of a Binary Tree
title: 最大层内元素和
summary: 求二叉树各层节点值之和最大的最小层号，根节点为第一层。
insight: 层序遍历天然把同层节点聚在一起；逐层求和，只在严格大于历史最大值时更新层号，就能在并列时保留较小层号。
pitfalls: 节点值可能为负，最大和不能初始化为零
并列最大值不更新答案

solutions.title: 层序求和
solutions.idea: 用队列逐层计算节点和并记录首次最大层。
steps: 根节点入队，level=0，bestSum 为最小整数
每轮先 level++，读取当前队列 size 个节点并累加，孩子入队
若 sum>bestSum 更新 bestSum 与 bestLevel，队列耗尽后返回 bestLevel

code.java: class Solution { public int maxLevelSum(TreeNode root){Queue<TreeNode> queue=new ArrayDeque<>();queue.offer(root);int level=0,bestLevel=0,bestSum=Integer.MIN_VALUE;while(!queue.isEmpty()){level++;int size=queue.size(),sum=0;while(size-->0){TreeNode node=queue.poll();sum+=node.val;if(node.left!=null)queue.offer(node.left);if(node.right!=null)queue.offer(node.right);}if(sum>bestSum){bestSum=sum;bestLevel=level;}}return bestLevel;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maxLevelSum(root:TreeNode?):Int{val queue=java.util.ArrayDeque<TreeNode>();queue.addLast(root!!);var level=0;var bestLevel=0;var bestSum=Int.MIN_VALUE;while(queue.isNotEmpty()){level++;var size=queue.size;var sum=0;while(size-->0){val node=queue.removeFirst();sum+=node.`val`;node.left?.let{queue.addLast(it)};node.right?.let{queue.addLast(it)}};if(sum>bestSum){bestSum=sum;bestLevel=level}};return bestLevel} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int maxLevelSum(TreeNode* root){queue<TreeNode*> pending;pending.push(root);int level=0,bestLevel=0,bestSum=INT_MIN;while(!pending.empty()){++level;int size=pending.size(),sum=0;while(size--){TreeNode* node=pending.front();pending.pop();sum+=node->val;if(node->left)pending.push(node->left);if(node->right)pending.push(node->right);}if(sum>bestSum){bestSum=sum;bestLevel=level;}}return bestLevel;} };
